notes.title: Free-To-Play Update
notes.content: Hello friends! This is a quick announcement to let players (and prospective players) know that Keep Me Posted will soon be updated to be free to play and download. There will be no changes to functionality or access for people who have already bought and downloaded the game. Thank you so much to everybody who has supported us!

notes.title: USC Games Expo Patch!
notes.content: Hi Everyone! This patch is to ease up some difficulty settings ahead of USC Games Expo (Which is tomorrow! Come say hi!). In the future, this will be a toggleable "mom mode," where you can choose to play on the regular difficulty if you're more experienced or on this difficulty if you're more interested in the narrative, art, and music. For now, though, we're just over-riding the default settings. Don't worry! If you want to play on the regular difficulty level, it should be available again in a couple of weeks.

notes.title: 11/5 Hotfix
notes.content: - fixed issue where post office walls would become indestructible after entering post office interaction area on later days

notes.title: 11/4 Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where post office room walls would not become destructible when loading a save.

There is currently a known issue with using the gamepad cursor in the Post Office UI screen for multiple days without restarting the game - it is believed to be a Unity Input System bug, and we're working hard to find a workaround.
